body: Wired Ghost's Q/W/R (skillshot-simplified damage+Silence, instant intangibility, fixed-position damage zone). First kit needing real status-effect state (silenced_ms/intangible_ms, hero_is_hittable()). Flagged (did not fix) a pre-existing rounding bug in Unicorn's W regen found while building the zone tick. Roster-fit audit: 8 of the 10 remaining heroes are structurally blocked by systems arena doesn't have (grid pressure, allies, multi-unit, cooking) -- only Frog remains a clean fit. 7 new headless tests, all green alongside full existing suite. Commit 9178fae. BACKLOG S170-32.
